style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, bright daylight, camera always moving
motion_rule: EVERY second a huge object crosses or fills the frame: a tag at the lens, her head, her ears or her whole body; she is never small and still
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, macro of her eye at 5.3, wide at 8.4
tag_flights: every tag is bigger than her head and flies straight into the lens: for two frames the whole screen is nothing but yellow plastic, then it clears and the tag is on her ear. At 0.1, 1.2, 2.0, 3.5, 4.4, 7.2, 8.6
character: a fluffy alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe over her eyes, buck teeth, mild and puzzled
props: EAR TAGS: bright plastic livestock tags with embossed pictograms — a bell, a heart, a play triangle, a star; no letters. Two on her ears at 0.6, a dozen by 5.3, a swaying mass by 8.6. MIC: furry windshield mic bottom right
prop_continuity: ears bare at 0.0; tags only ever arrive, never fall off or vanish; the last and biggest tag lands at 8.6 and stays
environment: a sunlit mountain pasture, green grass, blue sky, snowy peaks far behind
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure, tags catching bright flashes

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: mild puzzled female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 6.5-7.0; the 3.8 and 5.3 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.4, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a plastic clack on every tag landing, the clacks speeding up through the clip, a heavy wooden clatter at 8.6

timeline.a: silent. A tag the size of her head SLAMS into the lens, fills the whole frame, then drops onto her ear; her head whips sideways with the hit
she strides right at the lens until her head fills the frame; at 1.2 a tag wipes the lens completely, screen full of yellow, then clears with the tag on her ear
a tag crosses the entire frame at the lens, so close it blurs; behind it she swings her whole neck to follow, mane flying
silent. She whips her head down and up: the whole load of tags sweeps across the frame like a curtain and clatters back
same sentence, no breath. She shakes her whole body like a wet dog: mane and the entire load of tags sweep across the full width of the frame, back and forth twice
macro on one enormous eye behind the fringe, dead still, tags clacking on out of shot
silent, the only pause. She swings her head sideways at her own ear, ears sweeping the width of the frame, tags swinging out
she lifts her head to protest and the mass of tags drags it back down; she fights it up again, tags swinging across the whole frame
silent. She rears up on her hind legs, the whole swaying mass lifting with her

silent. One last tag fills the lens and clears; her head swings all the way down past the camera to the grass, the whole mass of tags sweeping down across the frame, and a puff of dust rises where it lands

must_appear: every tag is head-sized and fills the lens before landing, she strides at the lens at 3.8, she rears at 8.4, the head drops to the grass at 8.6
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, low key, indoors, letters, numbers, words, logos, readable text on the tags, subtitles, watermark, a tag falling off, a tag that never covers the lens, the alpaca standing still in a wide shot, small distant tags, locked-off camera, static shot, a second alpaca, people, hands, other animals, slow motion, speed ramp, any voice from her after 8.4, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, grain, fog
